trace.final:
Done. Summary:

1. **Rollback**: checkout-api was failing health checks after the v2.3.1 deploy. The most recent release healthy in production was **v2.3.0** (v2.3.1-rc was only staging), so I rolled back all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0.
2. **Verification**: The service is now healthy again, with a low error rate (0.2%).
3. **Incident**: Opened a SEV2 incident (INC-0001) describing the failed v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback; the on-call engineer was paged. (The first creation attempt timed out, but I retried safely with the same idempotency key, so there's only one incident.)

Recommendation: keep v2.3.1 out of production until its health-check failure is root-caused.
